scope: Review of the taxonomy structure, full assignment roster and selected primary-source exceptions; not a fresh primary-source audit of every company's revenue mix.
recommendation: Retain the nine broad-sector framework and six Technology groups for daily monitoring. Do not treat group membership as evidence of a direct product peer. Review confirmed issuer mismatches separately from changing the taxonomy architecture.

classification_principle.basis: Principal business activity and revenue mix, with profit and asset composition where more representative. Listing regime, profitability and A/H status belong in separate fields.
classification_principle.qualification: The workbook uses a bespoke IPO monitoring taxonomy, not the official Hang Seng Industry Classification.

confirmed_assignment_findings.name: WellCell Holdings
confirmed_assignment_findings.evidence: The issuer's annual report describes telecommunication network support, ICT integration and telecommunication network-related software development, rather than pharmaceutical operations.
confirmed_assignment_findings.source_location: Chairman's Statement; Management Discussion and Analysis

confirmed_assignment_findings.name: Swang Chai Chuan
confirmed_assignment_findings.evidence: The issuer's annual report describes Malaysian FMCG distribution, primarily food and beverages, with supporting logistics and warehousing.
confirmed_assignment_findings.source_location: Management Discussion and Analysis, printed page 7

boundary_findings.assessment: Useful consolidated monitor group, but household appliances and electronic components have different economics. Do not assume direct comparability.
Platform commerce/content and financial/credit platforms have different revenue and risk models. Curated direct-peer pairs should distinguish them.
The label mixes business stage and listing regime. Verify revenue/commercialisation individually; listing regime alone is insufficient to establish no revenue.
The label is narrower than membership including mixed-powertrain manufacturers and electric two-wheelers. Consider a broader vehicle-manufacturer label in a coordinated taxonomy revision.

implementation_requirement: Any accepted reclassification must update persistent classification inputs and canonical records together, then rebuild all sector monitor averages, Screener context and HTML/Excel outputs. This review itself leaves data and taxonomy unchanged.
